name: Jehoahaz
overview: Jehoahaz, son of Jehu, reigned over Israel in Samaria for seventeen years, beginning in the twenty-third year of Joash king of Judah. His reign was marked by persistent evil as he followed the sinful ways of Jeroboam, leading Israel into continued disobedience against the LORD. As a consequence, God allowed Israel to be oppressed by Hazael king of Syria and his son Benhadad, yet when Jehoahaz sought the LORD, God showed mercy by raising up a deliverer who freed Israel from Syrian oppression. Despite this deliverance, Jehoahaz and the people did not turn from their sins or idolatry, showing the ongoing spiritual decline during his reign.
